basis: observed static inspection of the candidate implementation; not proof of current OATD behavior except where separately linked to a live execution

observed_capability_assessment.basic_route_scope: Uses only the OATD basic GET search route and Record Details collection; it does not submit the advanced composer.
observed_capability_assessment.blank_control_assumptions: Requires blank language, country, earliest, latest and unchecked CC controls, relevance value 'relevanace', and 30 results per page in its basic result-state validator.
observed_capability_assessment.date_language_country_cc: No CLI controls for date, language, country, or CC-only limits are exposed.
observed_capability_assessment.detail_metadata: Collects Record ID, title, author, resource URL/format, publication date, university/publisher, and abstract; it has no extraction for the visible advanced subjects/keywords or department/discipline fields and cannot establish degree completion or full-text eligibility.
observed_capability_assessment.pagination_identity: Implements one forward pagination traversal with source total/range/rank checks and Record Details IDs. It has no two-pass stable-order option.
observed_capability_assessment.completeness_mode: Can label one traversal complete when user-supplied limit and max-pages exhaust the displayed total, but has no --require-complete gate or two-pass reconciliation required by this protocol.
observed_capability_assessment.count_only: No --count-only option is exposed; even a positive aggregate syntax test opens one Record Details page at limit 1.
observed_capability_assessment.report_ready: Generic PRISMA linkage can make a mocked/one-pass completed artifact report-ready; that cannot by itself meet this protocol's required two-pass identity completeness proof.
observed_capability_assessment.transaction_and_no_clobber: Writes atomically, but validate_output_paths only rejects duplicate CLI paths and atomic_write_json uses os.replace on the requested output path. It does not refuse an existing output path.

demonstrated_code_issue.reason: The candidate adapter lacks no-clobber protection and can atomically replace an existing artifact. Its one-pass, caller-bounded completion model also lacks the protocol-required --require-complete/two-pass gate. These are report-ready final-run safety defects, not a source zero or a reason to relax the protocol.

source_locations.finding: CLI lacks count-only, require-complete, passes, date, language, country, and CC controls; output is written after a single traversal.
Output-path validation allows existing paths and atomic_write_json finishes with os.replace.

demonstrated_code_issue.required_response: Preserve this pilot, stop further live querying, and send a separately authorized code-fix subagent. The fix must add refuse-overwrite semantics, an explicit strict completeness/two-pass mode, safe aggregate count-only mode, and review-required controls/metadata before a new pilot may test it.

live_execution_link: exec-001-native-zero.json used this exact adapter SHA with explicit --cdp-url http://127.0.0.1:9234 and succeeded only for an explicit native zero. That narrow success does not cure the static defects.
